Colombian rebels state kidnapped French soldier is alive

A Colombian rebel group has stated that a kidnapped French Foreign Legion soldier is still alive. The group confirmed the soldier's status, indicating he has not been killed. No further details regarding his condition or location were provided in the coverage.
